rules: Paid daily targets are hard minimums and are not silently reduced for expected-profit optimization.
Carryover survives date changes and PC power-off until strict public verification.
Do not count queue insertion, commits, local exit 0, editor/admin URLs, or invented URLs as publication.
Free NOTE never replaces or decrements the paid NOTE floor.
Before retrying an ambiguous publication, reconcile existing exact-title public pages to prevent duplicates.
Canonical Windows root is C:\SIDEHUSTLE_AUTO; do not create daily scattered ZIP/CMD runners.
